overview_description.description: Founded in 2019, Lentra is enabling banks in democratising digital lending through its SaaS platform. It empowers banks (& NBFCs) to create custom loan products and enhance customer experiences, through its API-driven modular architecture. Currently, Lentra's digital lending platform serves over 50 banks, has processed over $20 billion worth of loan applications, with 2 million loans being processed every month. Lentra supports its customers in expanding their reach, reducing non-performing assets, optimising operational efficiencies, and using Pay-as-you-go pricing for their growth. Lentra is backed by investors like BVP, Citi, HDFC, MUFG, SIG & Vy. To read more, please visit: https://Lentra.ai/

product.name: GoGetr
product.description: An AI-driven platform that automates and digitizes the lending process from application to decisioning, integrating multiple internal and third-party services for faster, accurate loan approvals.

product.name: MultiBureau®
product.description: A credit risk management solution that aggregates credit scores and reports from multiple credit bureaus quickly to support informed lending decisions.

product.name: BRE x
product.description: A business rule engine that enables configurable, automated credit decisioning and risk assessment based on customizable policies and data analytics.

product.name: 1LMS
product.description: A configurable, API-based loan management system that supports end-to-end loan lifecycle management across various loan types and lending models.

product.name: Auto Loans
product.description: A digital lending solution for automobile financing that supports new and used vehicle loans with automated workflows and fraud checks.

product.name: Consumer Durable Loans
product.description: A digital lending product for consumer durable purchases offering instant loan approvals with high straight-through processing rates and multi-channel integration.
